description:
About the company
 Our client is an automotive software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Build and ship full-stack features for a new North American product line, working from customer conversations to production code and taking responsibility for how well the product performs once it reaches users.
 What you'll do
 - Build and release full-stack features from first idea to production, with a backend-first approach.
 - Spend time with body shops, estimators and parts managers to understand where their daily processes break down, then shape the next thing to build.
 - Prototype quickly with AI tools and Python, then rebuild the strongest prototypes in a statically typed language.
 - Stay accountable for how well your product area performs in usage and returns, and weigh its benefit against the cost of building it.
 - Bring estimators and parts teams from hand-done tasks to automated assistants that act under human oversight, winning their confidence on critical repair jobs.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Proven record of shipping features end to end and owning whether they succeeded.
 - Evidence of product judgment as an engineer, having shaped what gets built rather than only implementing a specification.
 - Full-stack experience across backend and frontend, with a backend lean welcome.
 - Hands-on history of quickly creating early versions of software using AI coding assistants.
 - 5+ years of experience in software engineering.
 Bonus points
 - Early engineer or founder experience at a startup, combined with time at a strong engineering organization.
 - Experience building products for consumers or non-technical businesses.
 - Experience with statically typed languages and production use of Rust.
 - A genuine interest in customer-facing work and in what users need.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 260,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - Austin, Texas, United States
 - On-site
 - 5 days in-office per week
 - Full-time
